mount_hole_count = 4

            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (boss_radius, flange_thickness))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (boss_radius, flange_thickness + boss_height))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, flange_thickness + boss_height))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

bottom_edges = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[:1]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_edges, chamfer_size)

top_z = flange_thickness + boss_height
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, top_z - set_screw_depth / 2) * Cylinder(set_screw_diameter / 2, set_screw_depth)

for x in [-mount_hole_spacing / 2, mount_hole_spacing / 2]:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, 0, flange_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter / 2, flange_thickness)

part = solid_body
part.name = "flange_with_boss"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

plate_length = 80.0
plate_width = 80.0
plate_thickness = 8.0
corner_fillet_radius = 6.0
central_hole_diameter = 30.0
slot_length = 15.0
slot_width = 10.0
rib_height = 4.0
rib_width = 6.0
rib_offset = 12.0

solid_body = Box(plate_length, plate_width, plate_thickness)
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), corner_fillet_radius)

solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)

slot_center_x = plate_length / 2 - slot_length / 2
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(slot_center_x, 0, 0) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, plate_thickness)

rib_positions = [
    (rib_offset, rib_offset),
    (-rib_offset, rib_offset),
    (-rib_offset, -rib_offset),
    (rib_offset, -rib_offset),
]
for x, y in rib_positions:
    solid_body = solid_body + Pos(x, y, 0) * Box(rib_width, rib_height, plate_thickness)

part = solid_body
part.name = "plate_with_holes_and_ribs"
export_step(part, "output.step")
